name: frappe-hrms
description: Frappe v16 + ERPNext + HRMS on Dokku, deployed from a prebuilt GHCR image
_comment: The env block below is documentation only. Dokku does not read/apply app.json 'env' values automatically for docker-image deploys — set these explicitly with `dokku config:set`. Dokku only executes scripts.dokku.predeploy/postdeploy from this file, neither of which is used in this design (migrations run via the Procfile 'release' process type instead).

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Administrator password, used only by scripts/init-site.sh

MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: MariaDB root/superuser password, used only once by scripts/init-site.sh — see the note in that script

GUNICORN_THREADS.description: Gunicorn threads per worker (gthread worker class)
